# cubepath_object_storage_bucket_lifecycle (Resource)

Manages every lifecycle rule of a CubePath Object Storage bucket (one resource per bucket: it replaces any rule set elsewhere). Rules delete objects in the background, permanently: current objects after a number of days or on a date, noncurrent versions, orphan delete markers and incomplete multipart uploads. Objects are removed within 48 hours of their due date. In a versioned bucket an expiration only adds a delete marker: add noncurrent_days to free the space. Create and update wait until the rules are applied (seconds, up to about 12 minutes after a previous change of the same bucket). Destroying it removes every rule. Import with the bucket UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_uuid` (String) UUID of the bucket (cubepath_object_storage_bucket.<name>.id). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `rule` (Block List) A lifecycle rule (1 to 100). Each needs at least one action: expiration_days, expiration_date, expired_object_delete_marker, noncurrent_days or abort_incomplete_multipart_upload_days. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the bucket.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status: active, paused (the bucket is blocked or on hold: rules do not run), pending or error.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `id` (String) Rule ID: 1 to 64 letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores, unique in the bucket, not starting with cubepath-.

Optional:

- `abort_incomplete_multipart_upload_days` (Number) Abort incomplete multipart uploads after this many days (1 to 7; CubePath aborts them after 7 days anyway).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule runs. Defaults to true.
- `expiration_date` (String) Delete current objects on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, after today UTC). Not with expiration_days.
- `expiration_days` (Number) Delete current objects this many days after they are written (1 to 36500).
- `expired_object_delete_marker` (Boolean) Remove delete markers left without versions. Not with expiration_days, expiration_date or tags.
- `newer_noncurrent_versions` (Number) With noncurrent_days: keep this many newest noncurrent versions (1 to 100).
- `noncurrent_days` (Number) Delete noncurrent versions this many days after they stop being current (1 to 36500).
- `object_size_greater_than` (Number) Only objects larger than this many bytes.
- `object_size_less_than` (Number) Only objects smaller than this many bytes.
- `prefix` (String) Only objects whose key starts with this prefix (no leading slash). Without prefix, tags or sizes the rule covers the whole bucket.
- `tags` (Map of String) Only objects with all these tags (up to 10). Not with expired_object_delete_marker.
